 COMMON JUDGMENT

The Petitioners have filed these three petitions under Sec.166 of Indian Motor Vehicles Act seeking compensation for the death of Mr.Bhaskar N.R. alias Bhaskar Reddy and for the injuries sustained by the petitioner Smt. Kavitha alias Vimala and for the damages of the TVS Victor motorcycle in a road traffic accident dated 14.09.2020.

All the petitions have arisen Kavitha Alias Vimala vs Ksrtc on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86078067/
2 out of a common accident, therefore all the petitions are clubbed together as per order dated 07.12.2021 and common evidence is led and common judgment is passed.

2. The case of the Petitioners in all the cases  is that:
 4 MVC No.4708, 4709 & 4710/2020  SCCH  25  On 14.09.2020 the petitioner in MVC No.4708/2020 was going with her husband Bhaskar N.R. alias Bhaskar Reddy in TVS Victor motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA41EL1411 from Gudipalli - Rajendrahalli Road, Mulabagal Taluk, Kolar District.

At about 12.15pm when they reached Gudipalli Rajendrahalli Road, Mulabagal Taluk, Kolar District one KSRTC bus bearing Reg.No.KA07F1632 came from opposite direction driven by its driver at high speed, lost control, went to the wrong side of the road and dashed against the motorcycle.
Due to the impact the deceased and the petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries.
They were taken to R.L.Jalappa Hospital, Kolar wherein deceased was treated as an inpatient till 16.10.2020.
For further treatment, when he was being taken to Bangalore on 16.10.2020 he succumbed to the injuries.
After PM the dead body was handed over to the petitioners.
The deceased was hale and healthy, aged about 23 years at the time of accident.
He was an Agriculturist and earning Rs.30,000/ per month.

The Respondent is the RC  5 MVC No.4708, 4709 & 4710/2020  SCCH  25 owner of the KSRTC bus and liable to pay compensation to the Kavitha Alias Vimala vs Ksrtc on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86078067/
3 petitioners.
 3.

It is the further case of the Petitioner in MVC No.4709/2020 that, she was treated conservatively in R.L.
Jalappa Hospital as an inpatient and discharged on 21.09.2020.
She was a Homemaker and her services to her family is equivalent to Rs.25,000/ per month.
Due to disability she is unable to do household work.
4. It is the further case of the Petitioner in MVC No.4710/2020 that, he is the owner of motorcycle bearing No.KA41EL1411.
After the accident the motorcycle was extensively damaged as per the IMV report.
The repair cost was Rs.25,000/ at Garuda Motors, Mulabagal.
He has not made any claim from his insurer in order to avoid depreciation of the value.
5. Therefore, the Respondent being the RC owner of the KSRTC bus is liable to pay the compensation to the petitioners.
Hence this petition.
In response to service of notice issued by this court/Tribunal, the Respondent has appeared and filed written statement.

14. Issue No.1 in MVC No.4708/2020:

It is the case of the Petitioners that, the Petitioner No.1 is the wife, Petitioner No.2 is the minor child and petitioner Nos.3 & 4 are the mother and father of the deceased - Bhaskar N.R. alias Bhaskar Reddy.
In this regard, the Petitioners have examined the wife of the deceased by name Smt.Kavitha alias Vimala as PW.1.
PW.1 has specifically deposed this relationship in her chiefexamination.
Apart from that, to prove the relationship the Petitioners have also produced their and deceased's notarized copies of Aadhar Card as per Ex.P.13.
There is no contrary evidence to these documents from the respondents.
In the Aadhar Card of the Petitioner No.1 her husband's name is mentioned as Bhaskar N.R. and in the Aadhar Card of the petitioner No.2 minor child his father's name is mentioned as N.R.Bhaskar.

In the  14 MVC No.4708, 4709 & 4710/2020  SCCH  25 Aadhar card of the petitioner No.3 her husband's name is mentioned as Rama Reddy who is the father of the deceased which is mentioned in the Aadhar Card of the deceased.
The petitioners have also produced Inquest Mahazar as per Ex.P.8.
In this document deceased Bhaskar alias Bhaskar Reddy's father name is mentioned as Ramareddy.

Further,
these documents are public documents and they have got initial presumptive value under law.
These documents have not been seriously disputed by the Respondent.

The Respondent has not produced any contrary documents to Kavitha Alias Vimala vs Ksrtc on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86078067/

Under such circumstances, relying upon the oral evidence of PW.1 and the documents produced by them, this court is of the opinion that the Petitioner Nos.1 to 4 are the wife, minor child, Mother and father of the deceased Bhaskare N.R. alias Bhaskar Reddy.
Accordingly, Issue No.1 in MVC 4708/2020 held in the affirmative.

sentences.text: Therefore, in absence of evidence this Tribunal holds that the injuries sustained by the petitioner in the accident has not caused her permanent disability resulting in loss of income and accordingly the version of the petitioner in this regard is not acceptable.
Under these circumstances the petitioner is not entitled for compensation under the head of loss of future income due to disability.
However, it is pertinent to note that, the Discharge summary as per Ex.P.16 discloses that, she has sustained head injury.
Therefore, the Petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.40,000/ under the head of Pain and Suffering.

The Petitioner has stated that she has spent Rs.1,00,000/ towards treatment,
medicines, conveyance etc.,
In this regard she has produced medical bills for Rs.37,400/ as per Ex.P.17.
